sloka: भरतः प्रविवेशाशु पुरीमिक्ष्वाकुपालिताम् ।द्वारेण वैजयन्तेन प्राविशत् श्रान्त वाहनः ॥२-७१-३३॥
transliteration: bharataḥ praviveśāśu purīmikṣvākupālitām ।dvāreṇa vaijayantena prāviśat śrānta vāhanaḥ ॥2-71-33॥

translations.english: ﻿ He entered the city through the gate known as Vaijayanta with his horses exhausted. The doorkeepers stood up and amidst cries of victory followed him in.
